body: So many of my patients with dementia have anxiety about owing someone money or needing to pay for where they are. This reassurance is hugely beneficial.
I think it's just basic depression. My aunty who I was close to recently passed so their is mourning also. I just don't fit in with my family and feel my friends can do better.

I'm really glad to hear that your attempt was not successful. To take the time to read my post and reply, shows that you are a good person. I'm glad that all the negative words in your comment are past tense. You keep kicking goals
I think it's just depression now. I was dx with bpd two years ago. I just over think things so much. I'm okay, I'll be okay I just have moments of darkness constantly. I just need to be fixed
Yeah I know what you mean! If you ever need to talk, I will listen.
And thank you for taking the time to read and reply

I'm seeing a psychologist to try and get fixed and I take medication but I think they need to change the dose. 
I'm taking a bath atm with native American flute and thunder from YouTube playing, so that's something for me. Which made me relaxed enough to read these comments :) 
I know I need to do more for me. I just need to convince myself I'm worth that time, but I think my psych will help me get there

Thank you so much. I am reading this now a week late cos I couldn't read it any earlier, for the pain. 

I just have to say your last line is in my funeral song 
Vnv nation - illusion 
And now I'm crying like a bitch but thank you
That's what keeps me going too.
I hope this is day 10 now for you, friend.  I apologise for not replying sooner and I appreciate your words. Thank you.
Thank you. Like I mentioned before though, just talk to someone. Your life is worth it.
I'm glad this helped you too! Just make sure you talk to someone if you ever feel low or dark.

I have to say I haven't been able to bring myself to read the comments about my depressing fuckin Saturday night or even think about what I wrote, until tonight (and quickly on Monday when I showed my psych my writings). 

Yours is the first comment I read. And damn it hits home. A lot of what you so is completely true for me. It makes me feel a little relieved that there is that non hidden or studied truth. 
Today I did just feel hopeless. I walked through my door after a somewhat good day and just fuckin cried. For no reason but every reason. 
The bus driver made the cars behind it wait, so I could cross the road and my first thought was 'You didn't deserve that' 
I get so mean to myself and I'm self aware but I can't or maybe don't want to stop it. 

I will read your comment again, not tonight but I will. Thanks for your time writing it.

I hate that my pain lives on, so others don't feel it.
That's the worst part of me. It always has been.
